data.body:
AC verification against merged origin/main (HEAD e768151d, includes change 2471):

- AC1 pin present: PASS (pyproject.toml required-version = "==0.12.7").
- AC2 no workflow modified: PASS.
- AC3 guard passes: PASS (scripts/check_uv_pin.py exit 0).
- AC4 guard tests: PASS (pytest tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py -> 11 passed).
- AC5 make lint runs guard: PASS (Makefile grep + make lint exit 0).
- AC6 CI-log anchor: PASS (run 33230196661, 5 jobs, "Successfully installed uv version 0.12.7" present; the AC8/docstring fix landed as change 2471).
- AC8 single-source: PASS (count == 1).
- AC7: NOT satisfied, and it cannot be by this change. AC7 conflates two claims. The version-resolution fallback ("Could not determine uv version") IS gone -- the pin delivered that. But AC7 also requires the CI log to contain no "raw.githubusercontent.com"; run 33230196661 shows "Fetching manifest data" = 1 in all 5 jobs, i.e. the residual setup-uv getArtifact fetch to raw.githubusercontent.com is STILL present. That residual is a separate, narrower network call already tracked by follow-on bug 5caa-4b63 (beribboned-enstatite-hoopoe), linked discovered_from this ticket. The pin can never remove it; only 5caa can.

Ticked AC1-AC6 (verified true). AC7 left unticked -- I will not tick a criterion this change does not satisfy. This surfaces a scope decision (escalated to the operator): rescope AC7 to the pin''s actual deliverable (fallback removal) and let 5caa own the raw.githubusercontent.com-absence claim, OR hold 56b7 open until 5caa lands and the fetch is gone.
